notes: Provider Search stories defined across contract, logic, API, tests, and integration.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for provider search inputs/outputs
Added core logic story for vector + taxonomy fallback search
Added unit and integration test coverage story
Added embedding + data pipeline integration story

FIND-F-001-S1.title: Define Provider Search Schema and Contract
FIND-F-001-S1.description: Define Pydantic models for provider search inputs (query, location, specialty) and structured response outputs including provider metadata, scores, and fallback indicators.

FIND-F-001-S2.title: Implement Vector Search with Taxonomy Fallback
FIND-F-001-S2.description: Implement provider search logic using MongoDB Atlas vector search with embedding queries and fallback to NUCC taxonomy-based filtering when vector results are insufficient.

FIND-F-001-S3.title: Expose Provider Search via Find Care Facade
FIND-F-001-S3.description: Integrate provider search service into find_care_facade to orchestrate specialty identification, query expansion, and search execution for tool consumption.

FIND-F-001-S4.title: Provider Search Unit and Integration Tests
FIND-F-001-S4.description: Create unit tests for provider search logic (vector, fallback, filtering) and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from facade through service to MongoDB.

FIND-F-001-S5.title: Integrate Embeddings and Provider Data Pipeline
FIND-F-001-S5.description: Ensure provider search integrates with embedding generation pipeline and MongoDB data structures, including compatibility with text-embedding-3-large and indexed provider records.
